articles.title: Orange: Orange enters into exclusive negotiations with Verdoso with a view to a possible divestment of Globecast
articles.summary: Orange has entered exclusive negotiations with the investment fund Verdoso for a potential divestment of Globecast. Globecast, a subsidiary of Orange, specializes in content contribution, processing, and distribution services. This move, announced from Paris on March 25, 2026, represents a significant corporate restructuring for Orange within the telecommunications and media technology sector, potentially streamlining its operational focus.
